messages:
sophia_support: FYI customer ACME (prod) is seeing a clear behavior shift on SFT-chat model after yesterday's quant profile update to FP8/autoquant. They say summaries are hallucinating facts that were previously correct.

elaine_cs: ugh. can you paste the example outputs?

acme_integration_bot: [incoming message] call_id=ck_9a1f, model=sft-chat-v2, quant_profile=fp8-auto-2026-03, seq_len=512

sophia_support: here's minimal repro from them (prompt + before/after). Note: timestamps in their logs around 2026-03-15 14:02 UTC.
```
PROMPT: 
"Summarize the following passage:

'The Q3 revenue increased by 12% driven primarily by subscriptions and ad rev, while one-time hardware sales declined.'"

BEFORE (pre-quant, model=hosted-sft-chat-v2@sha:abc123):
"Revenue rose 12% in Q3, led by subscription and advertising income; one-time hardware sales fell."

AFTER (post-quant fp8-auto-2026-03):
"Revenue rose 12% in Q3, driven by hardware upgrades and new device sales, while subscriptions were flat."
```

elaine_cs: that's a big factual flip (subs vs hardware).

raj_ml: can you share their request headers & model config? especially temperature, top_p, and whether we routed to a fallback variant?

acme_integration_bot: headers: {"temperature":0.0, "top_p":0.95, "max_tokens":60}, route: primary (fp8-auto-2026-03) on us-west-2. No fallback.

thomas_infra: deploy-bot shows a profile rollout yesterday at 2026-03-15T01:10:22Z: fp8-auto-2026-03 applied to sft-chat-v2. Canary running 5% for 2 hours then global.

deploy-bot: rollout-log: [2026-03-15 01:10] canary apply -> 5% traffic; [2026-03-15 03:30] ramp -> 100%

sophia_support: ACME says regression appears cluster-wide starting ~2026-03-15 14:00 UTC. They supplied ~40 examples; we've attached a sample set in the ticket INC-4321.

raj_ml: quick hypothesis: FP8 compression may be altering attention/head scaling for short-context factual cues. Need to run diff eval on our downstream eval set and KL/divergence on logits for the same prompt.

elaine_cs: customer wants either rollback or urgent mitigation. asked for ETA 2h.

thomas_infra: suggest immediate mitigation: roll canary back to previous profile (int8-stable-2026-01) for ACME's org_id via routing override, while we triage global rollback. Can apply org-scoped override in the control plane.

raj_ml: I'll run quick reproducer locally on a GPU with both profiles and dump token-level logits. Starting now.

sophia_support: please paste diffs when available. I'm telling ACME we can either do org-override or schedule emergency rollback.

raj_ml: quick dump (excerpt)
```
PROMPT = "Summarize..."
LOGITS_PRE (top tokens probability): {"subscriptions":0.42, "hardware":0.03, "ad":0.12}
LOGITS_POST (fp8-auto): {"hardware":0.35, "subscriptions":0.10, "ad":0.08}
KL_div = 2.4
```

elaine_cs: that's convincing.

thomas_infra: I can push org override now. if you confirm, I'll add policy: route org=acme to model_variant=int8-stable-2026-01 for 24h.

sophia_support: do it. customer agreed to temporary routing.

thomas_infra: applying override...

deploy-bot: policy-update: route override applied for org=acme, target=int8-stable-2026-01, applied_by=thomas_infra, expires=2026-03-16T14:20:00Z

acme_integration_bot: thank you, reports initial samples returning to expected output.

elaine_cs: next steps: raj to produce a short triage note with repro, token-diff examples, and recommend whether FP8 profile needs adjustments (scale/fp8-clip) or should be disabled for sft-chat-v2. Also spool a canary re-run with tighter QA pass.

raj_ml: will prepare note and a small eval suite (100 targeted prompts) to run across both profiles. ETA 6h.

sophia_support: logging INC-4321 as <priority=high> and CC'ing eng-ml + eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: INC-4321 created by sophia_support: "FP8 profile caused factual shift for sft-chat-v2 - ACME org" assigned->raj_ml.

elaine_cs: I'll update the customer with next steps and the policy workaround. Thanks all. :pray:

sophia_support: fyi adding note to release notes about blocking FP8 for non-eval traffic until we finish regression gating.

thomas_infra: we should also add an automated regression check: after any profile rollout, run small set of fact-check prompts with KL threshold. I'll open infra task.

sophia_support: ok closing thread here, will follow up in INC-4321.

acme_integration_bot: [customer message] "thanks for quick action, please keep us posted."
